disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, and limits are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with Texas Parks and Wildlife before hunting or trapping.

sources.title: TPWD 2026-27: Fur-bearing Animal Seasons and Bag Limits
sources.notes: Official TPWD: recreational Sept 1, 2026–Aug 31, 2027; commercial nutria Sept 1–Aug 31; commercial beaver Oct 1–May 31; other commercial furbearers Nov 1–Mar 31. Bobcat and coyote are nongame with no closed season on private property. Seasons are modeled as explicit date ranges, never continuous_open.

license_summary.licenses: A hunting license allows noncommercial take of fur-bearing animals, but the animals may not be sold. A trapper's license is required to take fur-bearing animals when pelts or carcasses will be sold.
license_summary.bobcat_otter_tagging: Bobcat pelts require the appropriate CITES tag before interstate transport or sale; otter pelts require a department-issued CITES tag.
license_summary.timezone_note: El Paso and far-west Texas observe Mountain Time; the rest of Texas observes Central Time. Season dates shown are statewide calendar dates.
